initScript: setInterval(function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; if(e&&e.revealMesh){ e.revealMesh.visible=false; } } catch(err){} }, 50);

steps.label: diag
steps.js: (function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; var cam=e.engine.camera.instance; var wu=window.__labWuMesh; var sc=e.scene||(e.engine&&e.engine.scene); var V3=cam.position.constructor; var wp=new V3(); var wuInfo=null; if(wu){ var p=wu.position.clone(); p.project(cam); wuInfo={vis:wu.visible, pos:[+wu.position.x.toFixed(2),+wu.position.y.toFixed(2),+wu.position.z.toFixed(2)], ndc:[+p.x.toFixed(2),+p.y.toFixed(2),+p.z.toFixed(2)], scale:[+wu.scale.x.toFixed(2),+wu.scale.y.toFixed(2)], ro:wu.renderOrder}; } var big=[]; sc.traverse(function(o){ if(!o.isMesh||!o.visible) return; var n=o.name||''; if(n.indexOf('Grass_chunk')===0) return; if(n.indexOf('Foliage_chunk')===0) return; if(n.indexOf('Butterfly')>=0) return; o.getWorldPosition(wp); var pp=wp.clone(); pp.project(cam); if(pp.x>0.1&&pp.y<-0.1&&pp.z<1&&pp.z>0){ big.push({n:n.slice(0,28), x:+wp.x.toFixed(1), y:+wp.y.toFixed(1), z:+wp.z.toFixed(1), ndc:[+pp.x.toFixed(2),+pp.y.toFixed(2)]}); } }); return JSON.stringify({cam:[+cam.position.x.toFixed(2),+cam.position.y.toFixed(2),+cam.position.z.toFixed(2)], wu:wuInfo, rightBottom:big.slice(0,20), hiddenCount:(window.__labMoved||[]).filter(function(x){return String(x).indexOf('hide:')===0;}).length}); } catch(err){ return String(err); } })()
